messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Re: MLG after MLG filter
parts:
Hi Jennifer,

Yes, you are correct. MLGs are collapsed into existing MLGs. IIRC, smaller clusters will collapse into bigger ones. To see the relationship, you can create a contingency table of the original with the filtered. You should be able to use the following code:

table(mll(myData, “original”), mll(myData, “contracted”)) 

The original MLGs will be in rows and the MLLs in columns.
